My plot is small, only about a quarter hectare, and I am renting it here near the city. Since I am close to Dar es Salaam I try to grow something I can sell quickly at the market, so I put in a bit of fertilizer when I can afford it and use manure I collect from neighbors who keep chickens and goats. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer because the plot is rented and prices at the agrodealer are high, but a small bag of urea helps. I do most of the work myself with my wife, and only hire a few people when it is time to prepare the land or harvest.
